mapper.insert: INSERT INTO brand ( name, description, is_active, is_deleted, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{description}, #{isActive}, #{isDeleted}, now(), #{createdBy}, now(), #{updatedBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE brand SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, is_active = #{isActive}, is_deleted = #{isDeleted}, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE brand_id = #{brandId}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM brand WHERE name = #{name} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1 )
